item.name: PRICING CALCULATOR
item.label: Internal tool
item.description: Sales configures a programme on a board, adding or removing deliverables and applying a discount while the total updates live. The scope can then be turned into a branded Quote or Invoice previewed beside the client form and exported to PDF. A catalogue page lets admins edit programme prices, the discount floor and individual service prices, and the app also has history, settings and a client-facing present mode.
